rules.statement: In a partition action, a declaration can be obtained regarding rights over land outside the subject matter of the action only if it is specifically addressed within the scope of the case.
rules.supporting_quote: It is not clear how in a partition action a declaration can be obtained tl1a.t a land outside the land to be partitioned is subject to a servitude, for this in effect is what the plaintiff seeks. Our attention was drawn by Mr. Chelvanayakam who appeared for the 3rd defendant-respondent to the case of Kanthia v. Sinnatamby 1[1 (1913) 2 l. Notes of Cases 19.] where it was held that such a declaration could not be granted.
